digest.component_or_area: store epoch guard (sync and push union sites)
propositions: A stale clone with mismatched epoch must be refused at both sync._union_merge and push_tickets_branch non-FF retry sites, preventing silent re-union of stripped history
The epoch field must be stored in .store-compat.json as an opaque JSON string (ISO-8601 UTC instant plus random suffix), compared byte-equal only, never ordered or parsed

The state matrix requires distinguishing all combinations: record absent vs present and epoch absent vs present per side, plus corrupt/unparseable records and unreadable remote refs, each producing different abort vs compatible decisions

When epoch mismatch is detected at sync._union_merge, return without merging and leave the clone un-converged; at push_tickets_branch, return from the function to abort the retry loop immediately with zero further merge or push attempts
The remote .store-compat.json must be read via git show on the remote ref, not the local worktree, and git show failures (unreadable ref) must be distinguished from file absence in log messages

Older binaries reading epoch-bearing records must not error or fail closed; write_compat_record preserves valid existing string epochs but never generates new epoch values (only A6-1's re-add commit does)
